verdict.rationale: Base44 docs explicitly describe browsing community-created templates and starting from one instead of a blank prompt ([base44-docs-20], [base44-docs-32]), plus the ability to publish your own templates ([base44-docs-10]) and CLI template selection at project creation ([base44-docs-19]). Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation of the template gallery experience and details on template quality/variety.
